messages:
Elena (AE): quick sync — Acme just returned the MSA with 3 redlines and a PO asking for net30. they also want the POC order form signed this week. any blockers on our side?
Kofi (SE): on the POC side we're good on infra. need to confirm the model quota and whether they want dedicated capacity for the trial. that affects pricing on the order form.
Jordan (Acme Buyer): thanks Elena. we flagged an SLA item and an audit logging clause in the DPA. also can we get an itemized POC quote? procurement needs line items for cloud + support.
Marta (Finance): itemized quote is ok. we should avoid short-term discounted commits in PO; propose a fixed POC line ("POC - 30d evaluation") + optional add-on pricing. I can draft numbers if SE confirms resource assumptions.
Kofi (SE): resources: 2x A100-equivalent GPU hours reserved for 30d POC, model streaming + embeddings. add 50k tokens/day baseline. If they want dedicated capacity that becomes a reserved cap line with monthly commit.
Priya (Legal): I scanned the MSA changes — two are standard: (1) liability cap increase request, (2) alternate jurisdiction. we should push back on liability and accept their jurisdiction for EMEA-only customers, but Acme is US/EU so prefer our default.
Elena (AE): Priya — they also struck the standard indemnity paragraph and added an audit-rights clause in the DPA. can we accept limited audit with notice?
Priya (Legal): limited audit with third-party auditor and 30d notice is reasonable. counterproposal: include scope limited to security controls, no live data exfil. add our standard redaction language.
Jordan (Acme Buyer): audit with 30d notice + scope limitation sounds doable. on net30: internal procurement requires net30 for POC. any objections?
Marta (Finance): net30 for POC is fine. need to confirm our billing ops can accept a 30d term with the PO code they provided. please add Cost Center to the order form.
Kofi (SE): SE note: if they opt for dedicated for POC we've to reserve capacity week-of-approval. Elena — what's their target start date?
Elena (AE): target start next Monday. we need countersigned order form by Fri COB.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment to the MSA addressing indemnity, liability cap (keep at 1x fees), audit scope, and jurisdiction fallback. will mark changes as tracked for review.
Elena (AE): thanks — can you also add plain-language summary bullets for procurement? Jordan, I'll attach those to the order form.
Jordan (Acme Buyer): appreciate that. one more: can you put pricing as separate lines: POC infra, POC support (SRE/SE hours), optional dedicated burst.
Marta (Finance): confirmed. include payment remittance details and contact for invoicing.
Kofi (SE): tagging @contracts-bot to generate draft order form template we use for short POCs: 
```
Product: Redwood POC - Reserved Trial
Qty: 1
Period: 30 days
Resources: 2x GPU reserved, streaming, embeddings
Price: $X,XXX (infra) + $XXX (support)
Terms: net30
```
contracts-bot: generated draft order form id=OF-2026-9843. uploaded to /contracts/drafts/OF-2026-9843.pdf :paperclip:
Elena (AE): moving to finalize — Priya please post the MSA counter by 12:00 PST. Marta please confirm invoice flow. Kofi + I will prepare the technical kickoff doc for Monday. Jordan I'll share the draft order form and the summary bullets after legal counters.
Priya (Legal): will do. flagging one more: client requested a SLAs section in the order form (p99 latency). we provide SLOs in console; recommend referencing Console SLA + separate SLA addendum for Dedicated if they opt in.
Jordan (Acme Buyer): referencing Console SLA + addendum works. can you include expected uptime % for the POC? procurement insists on numeric targets.
Kofi (SE): POC expectation: 99.5% availability for hosted endpoints; if dedicated, SLA aligns with Dedicated tier doc (99.9%). I'll add monitoring/alerting expectations to the kickoff doc.
Marta (Finance): once order form is uploaded, I'll route invoice to Acme AP. please include PO number on the invoice and send pdf to billing@acme.example.com.
Elena (AE): great. next steps: Priya will push counters, contracts-bot created form, Marta handles invoicing ops, Kofi + I prep kickoff. Jordan — expect a countersigned PDF by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Acme Buyer): thanks team, looking forward to Monday's kick off.
Elena (AE): closing thread — will update if any blocker pops up.
